description: Resolve a legal entity to its Legal Entity Identifier via the GLEIF API. Supply identifier_type as lei or name, and identifier_value accordingly. Returns LEI, legal name, jurisdiction, status and registration dates. CC0 source data, provenance attached.

identifier_type.description: Whether identifier_value is a 20-character LEI or a legal name
